name: The Antarctic Dry Valleys

environment.climate: The ADV are hyper arid; a cold polar desert.
environment.temperature: Average annual temperatures here are around -18 °C.
environment.precip_type: Rainfall rare but can occur along coastal regions. No snow in valleys.
environment.wind: High; winds can reach speeds of 320 Km per hour.
environment.insolation: High solar radiation is recorded in the Dry Valleys. 24-hour sunshine during the southern hemisphere summer.

relevance.evidence: Described as the most 'Mars-like' environment on Earth: cold dry desert, polygons, gullies, cold-based glaciers, salts, subsurface brines, extremophiles; also human-mission/habitat testing.
